meaning:
ἀν-ευρίσκω
(ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:14 * ;]
to find out by search, discover (see Field, Notes, 47 f.): Luk.2:16, Act.21:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
